findings.current: And there was no way all those holographic windows had piled up during the three days I’d been out.
findings.defect: “I’d been out” adds a period of unconsciousness or absence that this sentence does not state.
findings.rationale: The source specifies only the past three days.
findings.replacement: And there was no way all those holographic windows had piled up in just the past three days.
findings.source: 겨우 지난 사흘 동안 저 많은 홀로그램 창이 쌓여 있었을 리도 없다.

findings.current:
> **System**
> Congratulations! [Update] is complete!
>
> We sincerely regret any minor inconvenience caused by the [Update].
findings.defect: The draft retains square brackets around UI terms inside a framed System panel.
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown rule says the System heading and blockquote identify the panel without square brackets around UI terms.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
> Congratulations! Update is complete!

findings.source:

- [업데이트] 진행으로 인해 시스템 사용에 약간의 불편을 끼쳐드린 점, 심심한 유감을 표합니다.

findings.current: Giving you a fitting reward for all your hard work and doing everything in your power to make the user’s experience more enjoyable—that was the true purpose of a kingly, god-tier System.
findings.defect: “Doing everything in your power” assigns the work of supporting the user to the user rather than the System.
findings.rationale: The System is the one providing material and moral support for the user's play.
findings.replacement: Giving you a fitting reward for all your hard work and doing everything it could to make the user’s experience more enjoyable—that was the true purpose of a kingly, god-tier System.
findings.source: 유저의 쾌적한 플레이를 위해 물심양면 도와주는 것이야말로 킹갓 시스템의 순기능 아니겠나.

findings.current: > [Update Reward] has been delivered to your Inventory.
findings.defect: The System panel retains square brackets around the Reward name.
findings.rationale: The framed System panel does not use square brackets for UI terms under the binding Markdown rule.
findings.replacement: > Update Reward has been delivered to your Inventory.

findings.defect: The item name retains System-panel brackets.
findings.rationale: The Item Window is already identified by its framed System panel.

findings.defect: The poem's final line softens the source's blunt profanity.
findings.rationale: The source ends the deliberately crude poem with strong profanity.

findings.defect: “Is that it?” turns his conclusion that the inscription reveals nothing into a question.
findings.rationale: He is angrily declaring that the discovered inscription is worthless.
findings.replacement: “It doesn't mean a damn thing, you bastards!”

findings.current: “……If you call him, we’re the ones who’ll get chewed out. Don’t.”
findings.defect: “Chewed out” narrows the threatened rough treatment to a verbal reprimand.
findings.rationale: 탈탈 털린다 conveys being thoroughly worked over without specifying that it is merely verbal.
findings.replacement: “……If you call him, we’re the ones who’ll get put through the wringer. Don’t.”
findings.source: “……부르면 괜히 우리만 탈탈 털린다. 하지 마.”

findings.current: But when his squadmates, realizing their comrade had died, rushed over, they found a bullet lodged in the little Bible he always carried over his heart—he’d been a devout believer, after all…
findings.defect: “Realizing their comrade had died” presents Johnson's death as fact, undermining the reveal that the Bible caught the bullet.
findings.rationale: The squadmates sense or assume his death; the source does not establish that he actually died.
findings.replacement: But when his squadmates rushed over, sure their comrade was dead, they found a bullet lodged in the little Bible he always carried over his heart—he’d been a devout believer, after all…
findings.source: 그러나 전우의 죽음을 직감하고 주위로 달려간 소대원들이 본 것은,

findings.current: It was a suggestion worthy of the eldest son of a textile-merchant family.
findings.defect: “Eldest son” changes 장손, the eldest grandson, and drops the family's wealth.
findings.rationale: The source specifies both his generational position and the family's wealth.
findings.replacement: It was a suggestion worthy of the eldest grandson of a wealthy textile-merchant family.

findings.current: “He’d like this as a gift, wouldn’t he?”
findings.defect: “He” supplies a male recipient where the source leaves the recipient unstated; the ensuing reveal identifies Young Lady Ju.
findings.rationale: Keeping the recipient unspecified preserves both the source's omission and Mujin's mistaken assumption that the gift is for him.
findings.replacement: “They’d like it if I gave it to them like this, wouldn’t they?”

findings.current: “You stupid, washed-up Embroidered Uniform Guard! You showed up without learning the password!”
findings.defect: “Washed-up” implies a decline from former competence rather than the source's insult that he is useless or incompetent.
findings.rationale: 폐급 attacks his competence, while 새끼 adds an insult omitted from the draft.
findings.replacement: “You stupid, useless Embroidered Uniform Guard bastard! You showed up without even learning the password!”
findings.source: “이 멍청한 폐급 금의위 새끼! 암구호도 숙지 안 하고 오다니!”

summary: The draft has several action, subject, and register errors, plus System-panel formatting issues.
